Commentary: Nuwan Thushara to Sahibzada Farhan, FOUR, slower-ball off-cutter and short outside off, Sahibzada Farhan waits and flat-bats it over extra-cover, well wide of sweeper cover and it bounces away for four
Nuwan Thushara to Sahibzada Farhan, no run, very full outside off, Sahibzada Farhan shuffles across and jams it straight to the fielder at extra-cover, on the edge of the ring
Nuwan Thushara to Sahibzada Farhan, FOUR, a juicy low full-toss on middle, Sahibzada Farhan swings it away to the deep square-leg fence. Thigh-high and that's so easy for the Pakistan skipper

Nuwan Thushara to Sahibzada Farhan, SIX, what a shot. The shot of the game so far. It's a slower-ball and short outside off, Sahibzada Farhan goes on the back foot and flat-bats it. You need the arms of a WWE wrestler for that shot. And Sahibzada though not at that level, shows what he is made of as he powers it all the way over deep extra-cover. Landed on the cushions and Sahibzada has a smile on his face. He certainly enjoyed that
Nuwan Thushara to Sahibzada Farhan, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Nuwan Thushara to Sahibzada Farhan, out Caught by Sahan Arachchige!! Fine catch at deep mid-wicket diving forward ends Sahibzada Farhan's innings. Low full-toss on middle, whipped away and it's a flat hit, dipping on Arachchige who judges it well and takes it with two-hands. Cushions the ball after the dive and comes up with it after getting up. End of a superb knock. Sahibzada Farhan c Sahan Arachchige b Nuwan Thushara 89(53) [4s-10 6s-4]
Shadab Khan, right handed bat, comes to the crease
Nuwan Thushara to Shadab Khan, no run, short on the stumps, Shadab Khan pulls and misses. Flies over the top-edge and the glove
Eshan Malinga [3.0-0-26-1] is back into the attack
Eshan Malinga to Khawaja Nafay, 1 run, low full-toss on off, Khawaja Nafay gets forward and shows the full face of the bat to drive wide of mid-off for a quick single
Eshan Malinga to Shadab Khan, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Eshan Malinga to Shadab Khan, out Caught by Nuwan Thushara!! Shadab Khan goes for a duck. It's short and pacy on the stumps, Shadab pulls and the top-edge goes straight up, Thushara is there at fine-leg to take it. He is a bit squarer but that's straight down his throat. Shadab Khan c Nuwan Thushara b Eshan Malinga 0(2)
Mohammad Imran Randhawa, right handed bat, comes to the crease
Eshan Malinga to Mohammad Imran Randhawa, no run, low full-toss on middle, hint of tail back in, Mohammad Imran Randhawa gets forward to push it back

Eshan Malinga to Mohammad Imran Randhawa, leg byes, 1 run, definite reverse-swing for Eshan Malinga. A short of length delivery that nips back in to the thigh pad, Mohammad Imran Randhawa misses the defence but takes a legbye

Eshan Malinga to Khawaja Nafay, SIX, Khawaja Nafay finishes it off with a six. It's a slower-ball on a length outside off, Nafay gets forward and gets under this, launches the loft over long-on. All the way and Pakistan take the game. Nafay with some theatrics as he puts his head down after hitting that, suggesting it was a no-look shot

21:45 Local Time, 16:45 GMT, 22:15 IST: Easy win for Pakistan. They may have lost 6 wickets but the result was never in doubt. Especially as their skipper Sahibzada Farhan and Maaz Sadaqat put on 92 for the 2nd wicket. Before that the openers added 54 as 70 came in the powerplay. Sri Lanka had no answers as Farhan blitzed the ball at times. Sadaqat the man in form started with a no-look six which was audacious and he complemented Farhan nicely. Sri Lanka fought back with wickets but it just delayed the inevitable. This is a chasing ground and there was dew which made the Sri Lankan fielders to use the towel regularly. Looking back now, they were at least 25 short. Stay tuned for the post-match stuff....

A winning start for Pakistan under Sahibzada Farhan as they go 1-0 up. The 2nd game is on the 11th of October at the same venue. We will be there nice and early for that one. For now that's it from here. Do join us then. Sleep tight and take care.
